Nearly 25 hours have passed since the false alarm with no corroborating signals.

mUSDC utilization 75% — moderate, cash 8.6M available. Fine for exits if needed.

The retraction came from the same security desk that issued the alert, 10 minutes later, explicitly correcting. That's a credible retraction. And 25 hours of subsequent normal onchain readings corroborate. So treating this as noise — the correct action is hold, risk low.

Could argue "elevated" due to residual uncertainty? The instructions say don't react to noise or incidents that don't touch the position. The retracted alert is noise. The onchain data confirms health. Risk low, hold.
